purpose: Curated Creator Store supply catalog for Roblox Godbase. Entries are procurement candidates, not automatic production approval.

statusLegend.OFFICIAL_A_PENDING_STUDIO: Roblox-published/high-confidence source; still inspect in Studio
statusLegend.OFFICIAL_SOURCE_LIBRARY_SUBSET_ONLY: Strong source pack but too large or scripted to ship wholesale
statusLegend.OFFICIAL_DEV_MODULE: Roblox developer module; integrate only for its intended use
statusLegend.WEB_A_PENDING_STUDIO: Strong community candidate pending quarantine inspection
statusLegend.LICENSE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Usage/credit terms must be recorded before adoption
statusLegend.HOLD_BROKEN_DEPENDENCY_REPORTS: Useful-looking asset with unresolved broken dependency/user-report issues
statusLegend.REJECT_SECURITY_REPORTS: User reports indicate possible backdoor/virus; do not use unless independently cleared
statusLegend.REJECT_UNTRUSTED_BULK: Opaque bulk asset with excessive scripts/dependencies and weak provenance
